summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry, PR 1759). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions, so all verification was by reading. Choices to review: wrap_file's return carries the same return-value/type-var suppression as open; the implementation signatures type mode as Literal["r","rt","rb"]; module-level open calls io.open to avoid shadowing the builtin. Unverified risk: on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract truncate/mode/name methods may make _BinaryFileReader non-instantiable; this needs a check on 3.6.
